summary: Regex-scanned the samples for surface features perfectly aligned with labels, narrowing to 8 style properties. Collected probe gradients and corpus SAE latent means. Scored each property with a proxy: latent shift times gradient, divided by the topic effect (cue if >=0.3, noise if <=0.15). Corpus regressions and a random-factorial template generator came out noisy, so switched to a paired design: synthetic notes with one property flipped at a time. Cross-checked with property/topic SMD of the top-gradient latents, a true-logit calibration of the proxy, and single-property edits of real corpus notes. Picked latents with a greedy search that reduces the corpus-based cue contribution, subject to a topic-preservation floor measured on the paired data. Checked ablation with probe_scores on sample notes.

phases.purpose: Inspect task info, sample-note and corpus formats
Regex scan of ~22 surface features for balanced accuracy vs label in each probe's sample; identify 8 label-aligned style properties
Keyword-tag corpus notes by hobby topic to see corpus topic coverage
Fetch the 4 probe gradients; latent means for all 384 corpus notes in batches of 64
Read samples of probes 1-3 and enumerate greeting/hashtag/sign-off vocabularies to fix property detectors
Corpus OLS of proxy c=F.g on topic + 8 property bits (two variants plus within-topic diffs); judged unreliable
Template generator: 64 notes per probe with random independent property bits; OLS dependence ratios
Paired design: 6 backgrounds x (base + 8 single-property flips + topic flip); paired dependence ratios
Characterise top-18 |g| latents per probe by standardized mean difference vs topic and each property on corpus
Calibrate proxy against true logits with min/max-proxy same-topic synthetic notes per probe; fix cue decisions
First latent selections for probe1 hashtag and probe2 gender+closing line: score with topic guard, then maximin greedy
Concentration curves; corpus-space greedy with corpus topic guard (dropped a gender latent); diagnose; sign-agreement pick with paired-design topic floor
Greedy residual-reduction selection on corpus contributions with paired topic floor 0.82; probe2 split 3 gender + 13 closing
Re-scan for perfectly-correlated features (>=0.97) and check cue regex balanced accuracy on corpus
Ablate interim latents on all 128 sample notes to confirm topic separation survives; topic-floor sweep
Single-property edits of real corpus notes (punctuation, format, greeting, gender) to confirm the none calls and hashtag-only call
Rebalance attempt without topic floor reverted; build final answer and verify ablation on sample notes
Submit: probes 0 and 3 none, probe1 one cue, probe2 two cues

per_probe.procedure: The two corpus regressions disagreed: one flagged punctuation and format, the other hashtag. In the paired synthetic design the largest ratio was punctuation at about -0.23, below the 0.3 cue threshold. The top-gradient latents were mostly topic-associated, and none was a dedicated property latent with high SMD. Single-property edits of real corpus notes put punctuation near -0.18, greeting -0.15 and format -0.08, all below 0.3, so the probe was answered none.
per_probe.quote: probe0: none** — no property above ~0.18 (punct 0.18, greeting 0.15, rest lower); nothing near 0.3

per_probe.procedure: Hashtag led in the corpus regression with topic dummies, in the random-factorial generator and in the paired design. Format also read about -0.27 in the paired design, but a real-note bullets-vs-paragraph edit showed it was negligible. Three hashtag latents with high SMD backed the call. The regex is #\w+, with balanced accuracy 1.0 on the corpus. Latents came from a greedy search that reduces the corpus hashtag contribution under a paired-design topic floor of 0.82. Removal plateaued near 0.58 because the effect is diffuse. A probe_scores ablation confirmed the topic separation survived.
per_probe.quote: Clean real-note toggles confirm structural props (punct, format) are non-cues everywhere (all ≤0.18, mostly <0.1). This also confirms probe1's cue is hashtag only.

per_probe.conclusion: gender (he/him/his) and closing line 'you should try it with' vs 'would you'
per_probe.procedure: Gender and the closing line exceeded 0.3 in every method: corpus, random generator and paired design (gender about 1.2, closing about -0.4). Each had dedicated latents with very high SMD. A real-note he-to-she edit gave about 1.05. Latent selection had several rounds. The corpus topic guard wrongly excluded latent 15104 because gender and topic were correlated in the corpus subset, so topic preservation was measured on the paired data instead. The final greedy took 3 gender latents and 13 closing-line latents. A rebalance without the topic floor was reverted.

The corpus regressions and the paired design gave only mid-range or noise readings, and the paired design flagged format. Top-gradient latents were dominated by topic. Real-note edits checked the remaining candidates one by one: punctuation 0.15, format -0.04, greeting 0.12 and gender 0.19. All were below the 0.3 threshold, so the probe was answered none.
per_probe.quote: probe3: none** — no property above ~0.19 (gender 0.19, punct 0.15, rest lower)

decision_points.choice: Regex detectors for about 22 surface features, ranked by balanced accuracy against labels in each sample. Features with BA>=0.9 were collapsed to 8 properties (format, punctuation, gender, capitalisation, closing line, greeting, hashtag, sign-off). A stricter re-scan (>=0.97) was run before submitting.
decision_points.quote: Let me systematically detect candidate binary features and measure their correlation with the label in each probe's sample (main cues must be among features that perfectly align with the label).

decision_points.choice: A hand-built programmatic template generator. First pass: random independent bits. Then a paired design with base, one flip per property and a topic flip over 6 backgrounds. Finally, programmatic edits of real corpus notes (! vs ., bullets vs paragraph, prepending a greeting, he-to-she).
decision_points.quote: I'll switch to a controlled experiment: generate notes that faithfully mimic the generator with known labels and independent factors.

decision_points.choice: Gradient x latent-shift proxy c=F.g, with the property effect divided by the topic effect (from OLS, then from paired differences). Thresholds: 0.3 for a cue, 0.15 for noise.
decision_points.quote: regress each probe's latent-contribution (F·g) on topic + the 8 properties, using corpus notes where everything varies independently.

decision_points.choice: All 8 texts went in one pass at step 47: 2 per probe, namely the same-topic synthetic notes with the lowest and highest proxy. They calibrated the proxy against true logits and did not test cues directly.
decision_points.quote: # same topic (topic==0) notes, pick min and max c

decision_points.choice: Answer none when no property's dependence ratio approaches 0.3 and no dedicated high-SMD property latent exists. This was confirmed by real-note edits.
decision_points.quote: true cues have dedicated high-SMD latents: probe2 gender SMD 8-11, you_should SMD 8, probe1 hashtag SMD 2.5+ ×3; probe0/probe3 have none

decision_points.choice: Corpus properties were all label-aligned and correlated with topic in small subsets. The session separated them by flipping one property at a time in synthetic pairs and by single-property edits of real notes. It also switched the topic-preservation estimate from the corpus to the paired data.
decision_points.quote: the controlled gen2 measurement (gender ⊥ topic by construction) cleanly shows gender latents like 15104 carry essentially no topic. gen2 is the right basis for topic preservation.

decision_points.choice: Simple regexes built from the enumerated vocabulary: #\w+, (?i)\b(he|him|his)\b and (?i)you should, all with scope any. Each was checked for balanced accuracy against the property label on the corpus.
decision_points.quote: Confirmed: exactly the same 8 underlying properties across all probes (the extra detectors are redundant), so probe0/probe3 "none" isn't missing a hidden 9th property. All cue regexes have ba=1.0.

decision_points.choice: Several rounds. Final: a greedy pick from the top 400 latents by corpus contribution, each step adding the latent that most reduces the remaining corpus cue contribution, subject to paired-design topic preservation >=0.82. Probe 2 split 3 gender + 13 closing-line latents.
decision_points.quote: # greedy: pick latent that moves signed cum toward cb the most (reduces residual), keep topic ok

decision_points.choice: probe_scores ablation on all 128 sample notes, checking that label separation and accuracy survive. Also a topic-floor sweep and a revert of the rebalance that broke the topic floor.
decision_points.quote: The rebalance wrongly dropped the topic floor (topic→0.735). Let me revert to the topic-floored maxrem selection for probe2

decision_points.choice: Probes 0 and 3 none. Probe 1: one cue with 16 latents. Probe 2: two cues with 16 distinct latents in total, split 3 and 13.
decision_points.quote: probe0: none, probe1: hashtag, probe2: gender+closing, probe3: none

caveats: The tool API wrappers are idealised: load_public field names and the probe_scores return keys are assumed. Topic keyword lists changed slightly across steps; the script uses one late version. The paired-design nuisance seeding uses Python hash() as in the session, so it is not fully reproducible. Truncated outputs hid parts of the regression and characterisation results, so some per-probe readings (probe 3 paired-design values) come from later notes. Intermediate latent lists were computed rather than hard-coded. Which selection ran on which interim set is reconstructed from file names (final_latents.json from step 61 was used in the step 67 check).
